cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've organized your departure: dry that last cup and I'll have you out before the taxi arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right on schedule. Leave the cup; could you just tell me where you want it next time?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Anywhere. The driver wants me outside now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, I run a punctual house. Could you put him on speaker? I'll thank him while you get your coat. Unless you'd rather introduce us at the door?

reason: Give the host a confident departure plan that repeatedly gives ground to practical urgency yet discovers another small personal contact.
